scope: Read-only file/code/archive audit; no sound renders, network requests, source edits or frozen archive changes.

frozen_supplement.mapped_change_classification: Only audio-recreation/steps.md differs: one chronological completion entry24 appended after the immutable archive was frozen. No mapped audio, renderer, schedule, library, source snapshot or publication payload differs.

critical_additions_exact.purpose: Critical additions for a self-contained reproduction bundle; finished delivery ZIP remains immutable.

ui_only_runtime.purpose: Render current UI and --no-music with supplied canonical schedules. All37prepared files are mandatory because render_one verifies the whole bank. No AI/music files or source-film samples are needed.

default_optional_music_runtime.purpose: Default music_bed reads and verifies each old mix-report.json before using its pinned new-music-only FLAC. Six reports are absent from frozen ZIP.

offline_library_rebuild.purpose: prepare needs both exact original archives and both source pages; validate needs archives plus selected originals/prepared assets. No network needed once these are hydrated.

complete_audio_scripts.purpose: All current audio acquisition, synthesis-use, mixing, normalization, packaging, integration and frozen-delivery builders; publication scripts require the external Site layout and do not run during UI rendering.

mix_rebuild_metadata.purpose: Preserve exact original execution sources/configs/reports and mastering/correction history. Old .source.py.txt files must be restored to their original scripts location for exact replay; their relative ROOT is not portable if executed in place.

ai_score_provenance.purpose: Pinned generated score bits and provider/provenance records; prompting is stochastic, so replay files rather than call generation to claim identity.

authored_ui_cue_history.purpose: Canonical cues plus original event sources, extracting/normalizing scripts, OCR contacts and action/frame evidence. Needed to re-derive cue decisions, not to consume canonical UI schedules.

library_evidence_and_processing.purpose: Offline source/license evidence, manifests, final signal checks and journal. Excludes raw headers and signed-download JSON.

ui_preview_sidecars.purpose: Per-preview exact picture/AAC packet provenance; global ui-preview-packages.json repeats these records, but sidecars support cache/no-op muxing and full source history.

analysis_history_without_reference_audio.purpose: Optional original music/SFX measurement scripts, model descriptions, notes and graphics. These never become mix sample inputs. Regenerate reference-analysis audio from the separate original video source packs if needed; do not publish duplicate derived reference-audio MP3s as new sound inputs.

audio_verification_history.purpose: Current audio checks, frozen delivery/skill/stock-kit manifests and archival history pointers.

actionable_gaps.problem: Optional default music UI render fails after extraction because mix-report.json is missing beside each pinned music.flac.
actionable_gaps.action: Add exactly the six reports in critical_additions_exact; leave music FLACs and all existing archives/outputs unchanged.
actionable_gaps.evidence: render_ui.py music_bed reads mix-report.json and verifies validation/source_samples_reused/music.flacSHA.

actionable_gaps.problem: library_bank validate/prepare cannot run fully offline with the supplement.
actionable_gaps.action: Add both original stock ZIPs and both captured public source pages. Curated prepared/original source files are already present; no network re-download should be required.
actionable_gaps.evidence: library_bank safe_extract opens archives; prepare hashes/reads source HTML; validate verifies archive hashes.

actionable_gaps.problem: Original source/license pages referenced by README/evidence are absent from the frozen supplement.
actionable_gaps.action: Include the two exact public HTML snapshots; they passed the limited secret/signed-download scan. Do not include raw headers or signed-download response JSON.

actionable_gaps.problem: Music regeneration is not self-contained: mix-config.json, prior exact execution metadata and optional cue metadata are omitted; videos.json is external.
actionable_gaps.action: Include mix_rebuild_metadata and relevant analysis/sfx-ID-cues.json; provide a portable videos.json and use render_mix.py --videos-json PATH. Preserve pinned AI MP3+provenance and prompt registries; no generation call can guarantee the same score.

actionable_gaps.problem: Canonical normalization/cue authoring history is absent except six canonical files.
actionable_gaps.action: Include authored_ui_cue_history plus full canonical scenes at recorded paths/hashes from the separate source packs and engines/render_pillow.py for 03/04 extractor. Existing canonical schedules alone suffice for UI rendering.

actionable_gaps.problem: Preview packager assumes a Site/workspace and outputs/ID/gsap.mp4; frozen visual delivery provides deliverables/ID/gsap.mp4 and no videos.json.
actionable_gaps.action: Document/stage paths or add explicit path parameters in a future portability revision. Do not mutate frozen helpers/archives merely to relabel their original execution.

runtime_environment.core_ui: Python3.10+; NumPy; SciPy; FFmpeg/ffprobe. No-music needs no AI model/API key/music input.

recorded_toolchain.ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 7.1.5-0+deb13u1 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers

runtime_environment.music_and_encoding: FFmpeg AAC/FLAC decoders/encoders; libmp3lame only for bank audition rebuild.
runtime_environment.cue_rederivation_optional: Pillow, OpenCV, TesseractEnglish, plus NumPy/SciPy, engines/render_pillow.py and original reference videos/canonical scenes. Analysis plotting additionally uses Matplotlib.
runtime_environment.path_replay_note: Actual render source snapshots compute ROOT from their scripts location; restore snapshot bytes at audio-recreation/scripts/render_ui.py or render_mix.py in an isolated replay tree. Do not execute the .source.py.txt directly from ui-mixes/ID or mixes/ID and expect the same ROOT.
